title: Impact of Relocating Bukit View Primary School
what_it_is: Impact of Relocating Bukit View Primary School

sections.label: MOE relocating Bukit View Primary School
sections.summary: MOE announced on 9 February 2023 that Bukit View Primary School will relocate outside the constituency by January 2027.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: We reflect this reality in our daily interactions with all political office holders and civil servants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: I shall now discuss the Ministry of Education (MOE)'s decision announced on 9 February 2023 to relocate Bukit View Primary School (BVPS) to a place outside the constituency by January 2027.

sections.label: BVPS used in HDB brochures
sections.summary: BVPS was specifically used to advertise the desirability of BTO units in HDB brochures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: In fact, BVPS was specifically used to advertise the desirability of these BTO units in HDB brochures.

sections.label: BVPS temporary shift to Shuqun site
sections.summary: On 18 May 2018, BVPS students and parents were told the school would shift temporarily to the former Shuqun Secondary School site from January 2020 to December 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: On 18 May 2018, students and parents of BVPS were told that the school, which was originally scheduled for onsite upgrading, would instead be shifted temporarily to the former site of Shuqun Secondary School for two years from January 2020 to December 2021.

sections.label: BVPS upgrading plan put on hold
sections.summary: On 11 March 2021, during the pandemic, BVPS informed students and parents that its upgrading plan, scheduled to begin January 2022, was put on hold.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: On 11 March 2021, whilst we were in the midst of the pandemic, BVPS informed its students and parents that the upgrading plan for BVPS, which was scheduled to begin in January 2022, has been put on hold.

sections.label: BVPS staying put, review ongoing
sections.summary: Students and parents were told BVPS will stay put, MOE will review project requirements further, and they will be kept informed of the review outcome.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: It is therefore well known that the move cannot happen, owing to the effect of the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: They were also told as follows: (a) BVPS will be staying put; (b) MOE will be reviewing the project requirements further; and (c) pertinently, they will be kept informed on the review outcome once it is completed.

sections.label: PCF partnership with MOE Kindergarten delayed
sections.summary: In November 2022, ECDA informed PCF that its partnership with the MOE Kindergarten at BVPS is delayed to 2027/2028.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: In November 2022, ECDA informed PCF that the partnership with the MOE Kindergarten at BVPS is delayed to 2027/2028.

sections.label: BVPS relocation decision surprise
sections.summary: The Government decided on 9 February 2023 to relocate BVPS, which came like a bolt from the blue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Against this backdrop, the Government’s decision dated 9 February 2023 to relocate BVPS came like a bolt from the blue.

sections.label: ACS consultation before announcement
sections.summary: A Mothership article dated 10 February 2023 noted the Government consulted ACS' board of governors for a year before the 9 February 2023 ACS Primary move announcement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: In comparison, I note from a Mothership article dated 10 February 2023 that the Government was in consultation with ACS’ board of governors for a year before the announcement to move ACS Primary to Tengah was announced also on 9 February 2023.

sections.label: Support for affected Bukit Batok families
sections.summary: By 2027 the child will be in Primary 5, and the question asks the Government's plan to support affected children and parents in Bukit Batok SMC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: By 2027, however, when the school is due to move to a new site which is at least two kilometres away, she will be in Primary 5.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: My third and final question is, having withdrawn essential primary school services, what is the Government’s plan to support affected children and parents in Bukit Batok SMC?

sections.label: BVPS essential service and oversubscription
sections.summary: PEPS and Keming Primary School are perpetually oversubscribed, so BVPS provides an essential service, and an MOE kindergarten decision was reversed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: To underscore this point, I wish to point out that PEPS and Keming Primary School, the two primary schools that are close to Bukit Batok residents, are perpetually oversubscribed for Primary 1 places for a number of years now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: BVPS therefore continues to provide an essential service to Bukit Batok, which is appreciated by all.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: There is also an impact posed by the reversal of a decision to operate an MOE kindergarten at the BVPS site.

sections.label: MOE relocation population demand reasons
sections.summary: MOE's 2027 relocation of BVPS to Bukit Batok West addresses population spread and demand, as Bukit Batok East's share fell from 45% in 2020 to 38% in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: MOE’s decision to relocate Bukit View Primary School (BVPS) from Bukit Batok East to a new site in Bukit Batok West in 2027 is to address the changes in the population spread and demand for primary school places within Bukit Batok as a region.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Three years ago, in 2020, Bukit Batok East accounted for 45% of the total Bukit Batok demand for Primary 1 places.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: This has dropped to 38% in 2023 and is projected to slide further to 20% or so in 2030, even after accounting for the recently completed BTOs that Mr Murali mentioned.

sections.label: Bigger campus and expanded intake
sections.summary: MOE decided to relocate BVPS to a bigger Bukit Batok West campus to meet growing demand, allowing expansion by one Primary 1 class per cohort.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Based on that review, MOE decided that it would be better to relocate BVPS to a new and bigger campus in Bukit Batok West two kilometres away, to meet the growing demand for Primary 1 places in Bukit Batok West and the adjacent Tengah Town.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: The new campus will have more and updated facilities to better support our students.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: This bigger campus will comfortably allow us to expand BVPS’ intake by one Primary 1 class per cohort, in addition to its current eight Primary 1 classes and this will give us flexibility to meet short-term surges in the demand if required.

sections.label: BVPS upgrading plan change
sections.summary: MOE put the upgrading of BVPS on hold in March 2021 to review project requirements, citing housing and demographic trends in Bukit Batok.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: This was why MOE had previously contemplated keeping BVPS at its current site with an upgrading plan for the school and had conveyed as such to Mr Murali.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: However, in the latest review, and with greater clarity over the medium- to long-term housing and demographic trends in Bukit Batok, MOE had to refresh our plans that would serve Bukit Batok residents and their children better overall.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: That is why in March 2021, Mr Murali and the parents of the students in BVPS were informed that the upgrading of BVPS had been put on hold, as MOE would be reviewing the project requirements further.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Mr Murali is right that MOE had changed our plans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: But we believe this change of plans for BVPS would be the better outcome for Bukit Batok residents come 2027 – and even more so beyond 2027.

sections.label: MOE and ECDA preschool planning
sections.summary: MOE updates ECDA regularly on its MK plans, including the decision to put the upgrading of BVPS on hold.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: MOE works closely with the Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) to facilitate ECDA’s overall planning of preschool facilities to meet the needs of every community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: We have been updating ECDA regularly on our MK plans, including our earlier decision to put on hold the upgrading of BVPS.
